Replay

Raw WebSocket transport

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

Use the raw WebSocket adapter for reliable messages, including binary control RPCs and text signaling. websocket_host owns a native TCP listener and bounded WebSocketPeer connections. websocket_join works natively and in browser exports. The adapter uses no MultiplayerAPI or Godot scene RPCs. Keep the owner at a stable address; close its public transport or call websocket_close to release it.

The Transport view accepts Reliable messages only and preserves the 64 KiB logical packet limit. Unreliable returns Invalid; this adapter does not provide an unordered channel. Accepted sends copy bytes. Small destination buffers retain the next packet. Connection IDs are assigned by the native listener and are never reused during its lifetime; a client addresses its server as peer 1.

Defaults allow 16 connections, 64 queued engine packets, 256 KiB input/output buffers per connection, and a ten-second handshake deadline. The listener accepts at most eight sockets per poll. Full connection tables reject incoming sockets; full outgoing buffers return backpressure. Incomplete handshakes and disconnected peers release their references. The ordinary Transport receive path discards text messages with a bounded loop.

Services that multiplex JSON signaling and binary control messages can use websocket_receive (including its text flag) and websocket_send_text directly. Packet identities come from the socket, never a field in received JSON. This is transport plumbing, not authentication: authority traffic still uses its MAC, request correlation, identity checks and durable coordinator decisions.

Room_Options.control_backend = .Websocket interprets coordinator as a WebSocket URL. Its default remains Enet. Control reconnection preserves the RPC client and request frontier. Gameplay may use ENet or the authenticated RTC path; selecting WebSocket control alone does not configure the gameplay destination.

The native listener accepts plain WebSocket connections by default. Supply server TLS options to websocket_host to terminate TLS in the adapter, or use a deployment's TLS endpoint/reverse proxy for wss:// clients. The provisioning connection describes the verified-TLS contract. Public TLS/origin configuration still needs deployment acceptance beyond the local fixture.
